styleAnswer.evidence: Measured facts favour the candidate. It shows 17 visible tones per tile, the same as prop-stall-cheese (17) and close to prop-well-roofed (20). Near-flat coverage is 2%, below the cheese stall's 13%. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted: dark purple beside the counter body and dark tones beside the toys, not a sticker-like black line. By eye, the counter has a top ledge, a front panel, and a lower shelf holding small items. The plush toys and coloured balls on top add clustered detail and varied tones. A careful artist would accept it next to the cheese stall and well.
